nodes.name: status_picker_sheet.dart
nodes.summary: Bottom sheet widget that lets a technician pick one or more booking statuses from a list, with selection toggling and apply/clear actions.

nodes.name: _StatusPickerSheetState
nodes.summary: State class for StatusPickerSheet managing the current selection set and rendering the list of selectable statuses with checkboxes/avatars.

nodes.name: technician_provider.dart
nodes.summary: Central Riverpod provider wiring for the technician feature, exposing data sources, repository, use cases, and view models for job cards, packages, appointments, search, and slots, plus request value objects for custom package items and job card package lines.
nodes.languageNotes: Acts as a large composition root with 37 internal imports wiring the entire technician feature's DI graph.

nodes.name: CustomPackageItemsRequest
nodes.summary: Value object bundling a job card number and category id used as a composite provider family key for fetching custom package items.

nodes.name: JobCardPackageLinesRequest
nodes.summary: Value object bundling a service request number and package id used as a composite provider family key for fetching job card package lines.

nodes.name: technician_location_service.dart
nodes.summary: Background service wrapper that configures and controls a foreground Android/iOS background service for continuous technician location tracking, including permission checks and lifecycle management.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses flutter_background_service with static state to act as a process-wide singleton coordinating native background isolate communication.

nodes.name: TechnicianLocationService
nodes.summary: Static-only class that initializes the platform background service, starts/stops technician location tracking, and ensures location and notification permissions are granted before tracking begins.

nodes.name: technician_tracking_coordinator.dart
nodes.summary: App-level widget that listens to authentication state changes and starts/stops technician location tracking accordingly, requesting location and notification permissions via dialogs as needed.

nodes.name: _TechnicianTrackingCoordinatorState
nodes.summary: State class that subscribes to auth state changes, requests location/notification permissions through dialogs, and starts or stops TechnicianLocationService tracking based on login state.

nodes.name: i_upcoming_service_remote_data_source.dart
nodes.summary: Abstract interface defining the contract for fetching upcoming services and updating appointment status from a remote source.

nodes.name: IUpcomingServiceRemoteDataSource

nodes.name: upcoming_service_remote_data_source.dart
nodes.summary: Dio-backed implementation of IUpcomingServiceRemoteDataSource that fetches upcoming service appointments and posts appointment status updates to the API.

nodes.name: upcoming_service_model.dart

nodes.name: UpcomingServiceModel
nodes.summary: Primary constructor accepting all upcoming-service appointment fields such as service name, status, dates, location, car and technician details.

nodes.name: upcoming_service_repository.dart
nodes.summary: Repository that bridges the domain layer to the remote data source, formatting date filters and delegating to the remote data source for fetching upcoming services and updating appointment status.

nodes.name: UpcomingServiceRepository
nodes.summary: Implements IUpcomingServiceRepository, formatting date range filters with DateFormat and delegating calls to the remote data source while resolving the stored auth user id.

nodes.name: upcoming_service_entity.dart
nodes.summary: Domain entity describing an upcoming service appointment with fields for status, scheduling, car, package, branch, and technician info plus a hasSchedule helper.

nodes.summary: Immutable domain entity for an upcoming appointment, exposing a hasSchedule getter that checks whether a date/time slot is present.

nodes.name: i_upcoming_service_repository.dart
nodes.summary: Abstract repository interface declaring methods for fetching upcoming services and updating appointment status from the domain layer perspective.

nodes.name: IUpcomingServiceRepository
nodes.summary: Interface declaring getUpcomingServices and updateAppointmentStatus to decouple use cases from the concrete repository implementation.

nodes.summary: Use case that cancels/updates an appointment's status by delegating to the upcoming service repository.

nodes.summary: Callable use case class wrapping the repository's updateAppointmentStatus call for cancelling/changing an appointment status.

nodes.name: get_upcoming_services_use_case.dart
nodes.summary: Use case that retrieves upcoming services for a date range and status filter by delegating to the upcoming service repository.

nodes.name: booking_detail_screen.dart
nodes.summary: Detailed booking screen showing appointment, car, package, and payment information, supporting payment initiation, cancellation, and opening a support chat tied to the booking.
nodes.languageNotes: Large stateful screen (777 lines) combining payment webview navigation, status parsing heuristics, and several small private layout widget classes.

nodes.name: _BookingDetailScreenState
nodes.summary: State class handling payment initiation/polling, cancellation confirmation dialogs, chat navigation, and status-driven UI decisions for the booking detail screen.

nodes.name: _HeaderCard
nodes.summary: Private stateless widget rendering the booking header card with vehicle title, plate, and status badge.

nodes.name: _IconTextRow
nodes.summary: Private stateless widget rendering an icon next to a text label, reused across booking detail sections.

nodes.name: customer_appointments_screen.dart
nodes.summary: Customer-facing screen listing upcoming appointments with date-range and status filters, loading/empty/error states, and navigation to booking detail.
nodes.languageNotes: Large stateful screen (840 lines) composed of several small private widgets for loading skeletons, empty/error states, login prompt, and a filter bar.

nodes.name: _CustomerAppointmentsScreenState

nodes.name: _UpcomingServiceLoadingCard

nodes.name: _SkeletonLine

nodes.name: _UpcomingServiceEmpty

nodes.name: _UpcomingServiceErrorCard

nodes.name: _LoginPromptCard

nodes.name: _FilterBar

nodes.name: _FilterButton

nodes.name: upcoming_service_state.dart
nodes.summary: Sealed state hierarchy (initial, loading, loaded, empty, error) representing the fetch status of the upcoming services list.

nodes.name: booking_card.dart
nodes.summary: Reusable card widget summarizing a booking (car, plate, package, date/time, location, technician, status) with a tap handler, used in appointment lists.

nodes.summary: Riverpod provider wiring for the upcoming-service feature, exposing the remote data source, repository, use cases, and the two view models (list and action) for dependency injection.
